answer: Bind each identity to one master mariner certificate, the licence to command a merchant ship, earned up a terrace of stages: cadet, officer, master, checked live against registry, manifest and medical file. One certificate backs exactly one identity; a second claim is rejected. The climb takes 3 years of logged sea time and 2,800 units in fees: 100 fakes need 100 captains, 300 sea-years, 280,000 units, and no money buys a haven from sea time. Cheapest cheat: buying a retired captain's paper, but the seller surrenders their own backing, and forged sea-time fails the quartz-hard public manifest.
